summary: SKYX Platforms closed its merger with Deako, Inc. on October 13, 2026, under a September 9, 2026 agreement, making Deako a wholly-owned subsidiary. SKYX issued 25,000,000 common shares to Deako securityholders, subject to a 12-month lock-up releasing 25% at 12, 15, 18 and 21 months. Post-merger ownership is roughly 84.4% legacy SKYX and 15.6% former Deako holders. SKYX also paid $4,000,000 cash and delivered an $8,500,000 12% senior secured note. Watch escrow distributions, Senior Lender 10b5-1 sales and share overhang.
